identification: Three byte-mutated stripped Linux x86-64 Mirai-derived/uClibc bots
method: atomscan before/after including the XOR-decoded shell child
cleave facts for each sample, including decoded strings
Rizin and objdump static execution-path review; no sample execution

shared_evidence.behavior: Main initializes the encoded string table; selects daemon aliases, copies one to argv[0], and calls prctl(PR_SET_NAME=15) with another. Selection at 0x404fb0.
Autonomous forked scanner creates an AF_INET/SOCK_RAW/IPPROTO_TCP socket, constructs SYN packets with destination port 23 at 0x40680e, and initializes weighted username/password pairs.
Credential initialization copies allocated username/password strings and XORs each byte with 0x22; decoded device credentials include juantech, smcadmin and xmhdipc.
Telnet state machine sends the selected username and password through send; login/shell-prompt state transitions and retry handling establish credential attack code.
Connected datagram and raw IPv4/UDP routines both retain bound send calls and backward target-sweep branches.

Eight 32-bit table words each supply four XOR byte lanes; effective table key is 0x51. Decoded content includes daemon aliases, procfs paths, shell probes and a temporary-directory deletion/mkdir command.
Attack-record parser reads duration, vector, target count, address/mask records and options; 0x400633 hands them to the timed forked worker/registered vector dispatcher at 0x4001c0.

samples.difference: 0x40b45f loads syscall 44 (sendto), replacing recvfrom(45). Do not claim an intact incoming-task path. Retained credential attack and two flood implementations plus process disguise establish hostile purpose without requiring runtime success.

0x405b36 targets ret at 0x40b44b. EAX still holds the nonzero frame length: this skips only the body-availability peek. Header consumption at 0x405b5b, body recv at 0x405b85 and parser at 0x405ba1 remain. Restore task coverage.

0x405ba1 targets 0x400411, omitting REX.W. This executes mov [rsp-0x30],ebx then the original parser; it can dispatch attacks before returning with a partly corrupted RBX save. Restore task coverage; do not assume the whole routine is skipped.

judgment_context: No authenticated package/version/provenance or test-harness context accompanies these standalone ELFs. Filenames alone do not establish benign fixture deployment. Autonomous credential attacks, retained flood code and disguise tip the verdict; authorization and runtime outcome are unknown.
rule_changes: Add a notable PR_SET_NAME operation with a bound relative call to the prctl syscall wrapper.
Add suspicious credential-scanner/process-renaming/daemon-alias co-occurrence; do not infer name dataflow from the matcher.
Generalize the existing task matcher for the executable 32-bit first save and an optional body peek replaced by a ret in .text; keep body receive and parser bindings.
Correct the historical mutation-test expectations for those still-executable paths.
retained_coverage: Every prior finding is retained with unchanged criticality, including both decoded-shell-child observations. No removed or narrowed shared rules.
remaining_disagreements: No binary verdict/classifier disagreement: all remain classified malicious above 0.999.
